source: DK Contest Details/Week 7/Screenshots/ — 57 contest-detail captures (one each), 2026-10-22
note: 57 contests on the Sunday 10/25 main slate, lock 1:00pm ET -- the FULL lobby this time, not a budget-filtered subset. 6 reuse a payout grid already captured in a prior week, verified by an EXACT fee+field match before reuse, not by name alone -- that check caught two false positives: the Millionaire's field size is 147,000 this week against 161,700 stored, and '$5K Mini Gridiron' was never actually saved to payouts.json despite looking like a repeat. Both are recorded as summary-only instead. For the rest, every contest's own fee, field size, total pool and paid-places count is captured and is enough to rank all 57 by RAKE; the full per-place tier table was not captured for 50 of them to keep this within a reasonable scope -- re-screenshot a specific contest's remaining pages if its exact payout at a given finish is needed.
